test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some papers are pencils.

Some pencils are boards.

**Conclusions:**

I. No paper is a board.

II. All papers are boards.

III. Some boards are not papers.
solution:
Given that, 

 
• Some papers are pencils.
 
• Some pencils are boards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d645afb68bde93c4c1e31e179f60972c27c854589bc0d9560df7bda55dc0693a.png] 

Let us check all the conclusions as:

I. No paper is a board → Unfollow: Since given that some papers are pencils and some pencils are boards. So, some boards can be papers. This is not true.

II. All papers are boards → Unfollow: Since given that some papers are pencils and some pencils are boards. So, some boards can be papers but no all. This is not true.

III. Some boards are not papers → Unfollow: Since given that some papers are pencils and some pencils are boards. So, some boards can be papers. This is not true.

Thus, none of the conclusions follows.

Hence, option 4 is correct.
